run_preprocess_squad: run the SQuAD dataset preprocessing script to tokenize and annotate training data with a specified tokenizer
load_dataset: load a SQuAD JSON dataset file and extract questions, answers, and contexts into separate lists
tokenize_text: tokenize input text and return words, offsets, POS tags, lemmas, and NER entities using a global tokenizer
process_dataset: process a SQuAD dataset with multiprocessing to tokenize questions and contexts with lemma, POS, and NER annotations
find_answer: find the start and end token indices matching character offsets for an answer span in a document
